scope: Derived registry of already recorded static power and Pi encoded-input timing; no new measurement and no adaptive-policy result

status_vocabulary.measured: directly observed in the cited existing run/report
status_vocabulary.derived: computed only from cited measured values
status_vocabulary.unmeasured: no suitable existing observation; numeric value remains null
status_vocabulary.proxy: measured under a different cadence/residency and not interchangeable

device.measurement_point: Pi USB input/load side; not AC wall
device.instrument_limit: uncalibrated meter, user-accepted approximately 5.4 V supply, one Pi; no ambient thermometer

cadence_separation.physical_static: TON-IoT only; one 100-row encoded batch each second for 1800 seconds; all four models resident; 1 Hz meter and telemetry
cadence_separation.pi_tight_loop: all three datasets; each model timed sequentially for 1000 consecutive 100-row calls after 20 warmups; no meter and no one-second pacing
cadence_separation.forbidden_combination: Do not multiply or otherwise combine the two rhythms into energy per batch without a separately justified calibration.

resident_physical_inputs.note: The common model/data hashes are identical across v1/v2/v3; only the transport/control worker revision changed.

entries.device: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B Rev 1.5, 8 GB, aarch64

preprocessing.execution_status: not executed; no inference batch was invoked

entries.physical_cadence: measured for 1800 seconds at 1 Hz with no inference calls; batch size 100 remained the configured active-profile unit
entries.target_scheduler_residency_semantics: all four TON models stay loaded; idle and action switches do not load or unload a model
entries.power_residency_semantics: TinyDT, LightLR, MedRF, and HeavyMLP were all loaded, parity-checked, and warmed; telemetry and control remained active, but no model was invoked inside each second
entries.power_measurement_point: POWER-Z KM003C at the Pi USB input/load side, sampled at 1 Hz; not AC-wall power
entries.latency_measurement_point: unmeasured for idle; no predict call was made

power.scope: uncalibrated USB meter; user-accepted above-label 5 V supply; whole Pi load-side power

temperature.response_note: Instrumented idle temperatures are not a calibrated response curve.

uncertainty.summary: Power: n=3 sequential instrumented-idle profiles, sample SD and two-sided Student-t 95% CI (df=2); single Pi and uncalibrated meter. No inference-latency uncertainty applies.

known_gaps.requirement: Measure action-to-action switching under the final all-four-resident scheduler semantics; do not insert cold load/unload cost.
Measure the first batch after a scheduler action transition; existing reports used 20 warmup calls and cannot supply it.
Calibrate only if required by the final scheduler; existing light-load temperature range does not prove a hot-condition response or safety.
Keep null unless dataset-specific physical measurement or an explicit, separately reviewed proxy assumption is introduced.
